# bAIble v2

## Loading rule

Discoverable does not mean loaded, active or authorized. Use the graph to discover the full public capability space, load the current canonical contract when a mechanism becomes relevant, and never infer authority from capability or access.

If normal repository navigation works, prefer the current repository files. Use these absolute raw URLs as an access fallback. Material under history/ is provenance, not active guidance.
